source_snapshot.procedure: Run `ipmitool sdr elist`, physically remove and insert the module, observe sensor status transitions and verify corresponding SEL records; source clears logs first.
source_snapshot.criteria: Temperature changes normally; settings including SDR type match SPEC; SEL records every threshold event; the system performs the specified threshold response such as fan-speed change or shutdown; all STATUS_PSU1~6 pass.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO correctly reserves physical PSU service for an operator but does not address six-slot applicability, feed-group survivor capacity, the copied thermal criteria or duplicate identity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED correctly identifies the status-versus-temperature conflict and power risk. The source can be retained completely by separate per-slot presence/load-transfer and thermal-threshold checkpoints with Project-bound parameters.

old_problem: The historical review kept Pending, Source Conflict and BLOCKED because six physical PSU status transitions were judged by temperature-threshold criteria, and the source lacked fitted-slot, feed, event, capacity, service and recovery authority. Wistron-BMC-00090-V003 also labels row 1522's unrelated five-reboot test, so a code-only match could assign reboot evidence to this physical PSU case.
disposition_reason: Create an explicit PSU1..PSU6 applicability matrix; every fitted slot is tested independently and every unpopulated/unsupported slot needs versioned Project SPEC evidence for N/A, never PASS. For each applicable slot, prove physical presence/status plus raw SEL, identify its AC feed/group, calculate the post-removal capacity and imbalance of every surviving feed group, observe transfer, then restore the same serial and full sharing before advancing. Preserve Criteria 1-4 as a separately authorized temperature threshold/SEL/protection matrix after all PSUs recover; never heat the system by prolonging a PSU removal. Duplicate row 1522 remains a distinct reboot variant. Standard IPMI provides power-supply event semantics, while platform population, OEM mapping, feed limits and thermal response are bounded Project configuration, not reasons to leave the review decision unresolved.
decision_basis: XLSX row 800, physical adjacent row 801, duplicate-code row 1522, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest and full historical V3.1 record were independently read. Formal queue reconstruction identifies row 803 / variant f032aed05b0c1450 as the next missing case.

Duplicate row 1522 / variant b053731ba15755a2 is `Reboot 5 times` with a reboot-cycle script, 30/60-minute duration and OS/device-log criteria. A reboot does not create per-slot PSU absence, transfer or reinsertion evidence; both Source Keys/Variants remain separate.

IPMI v2.0 Power Supply sensor type 08h has sensor-specific offsets for presence, failure, predictive failure, input lost, input lost/out-of-range and configuration error. Raw event direction/data is necessary to tell module presence from an AC feed condition or PSU fault.

SDR identity fields and Get Sensor Reading/Event Status establish the sensor-to-entity contract; SEL records establish generator, sensor type/number, assertion/deassertion and event data. A high-level `ipmitool sdr elist` line is supporting evidence, not authority for six physical slot/feed assignments.

Total chassis wattage alone is insufficient for a six-PSU topology. Removing one member may overload its surviving feed group, violate N+N/N+1 policy or unbalance phases even when aggregate nameplate capacity exceeds load; acceptance must use measured demand and Project derating per group.

Normal temperatures during a bounded slot service prove a safety envelope, not the copied `each threshold` requirement. The latter needs a distinct sensor/threshold/hysteresis/SEL/controller-response matrix after full power redundancy is restored.

ED-02 preserves the duplicate rows; ED-03 and ED-13 allow a standard IPMI draft but not invented OEM event meanings; ED-15 governs SPEC-backed N/A; ED-17/ED-25 require operator-controlled fixtures and hardware; ED-18/ED-30 require approved thresholds; ED-19 protects SEL; ED-26 through ED-30 and ED-33 through ED-38 retain independent coverage, point confirmation, recovery and engineer verdicts.

test_case.test_name: STATUS_PSU1~6 per-slot presence, feed-group transfer, SEL and thermal protection
test_case.purpose: Verify all six logical PSU positions are authoritatively accounted for, every fitted PSU independently asserts/deasserts the correct status and SEL during approved service, each affected feed group safely absorbs and releases load, full serial-bound redundancy returns before the next slot, and all retained temperature thresholds/protective responses pass separately.
required_package: Versioned PSU1..PSU6 applicability/topology table: fitted/N/A authority, physical slot, module model/serial/firmware, FRU/entity, latch, PMBus address, AC feed/PDU/phase/group, redundancy domain and permitted service state

Per-slot BMC oracle: STATUS_PSU owner/LUN/number/ID, SDR record/type, sensor/event-reading type, assertion/deassertion masks, normal/present/absent/failure/input-loss states and exact raw SEL generator/sensor/event-data mapping

Six-slot power budget: baseline and planned workload, per-feed/group measured input, survivor rated/derated capacity, redundancy policy, imbalance/share tolerances, rail limits, removal order constraints and worst-case single-slot analysis

Vendor-approved one-slot-at-a-time removal/reinsertion SOP with operator, connector/latch/feed sequencing, maximum dwell, same-serial restoration, inspection, aborts and powered-down alternative explicitly labeled for lost live-transfer coverage

Pinned read-only collection package for IPMI/SEL, PMBus, PDU/feed, rails, BMC/OOB and host telemetry with synchronized time and protected exports; validated source script/parser revision and platform firmware/SDR versions

Separate Project thermal matrix: relevant sensors, units/conversion, every applicable threshold/hysteresis, expected SEL plus fan/throttle/shutdown response, calibrated fixture/profile, safe ceiling and recovery; SPEC evidence for each N/A
Immediate approval for each applicable slot action and each thermal stimulus, with tested OOB recovery and named power/thermal owners
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED ATTENDED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Export/hash SEL and related logs without clearing; inventory all PSU1..PSU6 entries and prove each N/A. Capture raw SDR/status, module/slot/serial/feed/group, PMBus/PDU input-output, rails, load share, redundancy, fan/temperature and host/BMC baseline. Follow the Project-approved slot order. Before each applicable PSU action, recompute measured group demand versus surviving derated capacity and imbalance limits, display exact identity/SOP/dwell/expected event/aborts/recovery, and obtain immediate approval. A qualified operator removes only that named module. Read-only monitoring must capture mapped presence/status and raw SEL direction/data, group load redistribution, rail and host continuity. Reinsert/secure the same serial once, restore its feed, and prove correct status/SEL recovery, stable sharing and full redundancy before the next slot. After all fitted slots recover, run a separately confirmed calibrated thermal profile for each applicable temperature threshold, recording reading/hysteresis, SEL and specified fan/throttle/shutdown response with OOB recovery. Never service an N/A/wrong slot, remove multiple PSUs, use aggregate capacity only, prolong absence for heat, alter thresholds/share controls, reuse row-1522 reboot evidence, clear logs, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL automatically.
test_case.expected_result: Each logical PSU1..PSU6 position has a fitted test result or authoritative N/A. Each fitted slot independently shows the exact present-to-absent/fault-to-present status and raw SEL assertion/deassertion for its mapped identity; all survivor feed groups remain inside derated capacity, share/imbalance and rail limits; host/BMC stay available and temperatures remain inside the service envelope. The same module/feed is restored and full redundancy/share returns before the next slot. Separately, all applicable temperature thresholds assert/deassert at approved readings/hysteresis with exact SEL and prescribed fan/throttle/shutdown behavior, followed by full recovery.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires complete six-position applicability, all fitted per-slot physical transitions, exact raw status/SEL correlation, measured per-group headroom and transfer, stable rails/host/BMC, bounded temperature, same-serial reinsertion, complete redundancy/share recovery and the independent threshold/protection matrix. Missing slot disposition, undocumented N/A, code-only duplicate match, reboot evidence, static read, textual SEL alone, presence confused with AC input loss, aggregate-only capacity, skipped feed group, unexpected overload/rail/redundancy/thermal behavior, missing deassertion, powered-down service claimed as live transfer, retry or incomplete recovery cannot pass. Missing Project inputs mean NOT READY; defects are FAIL/BLOCKED for execution, not N/A.
safety_gate: Preserve/hash complete existing SEL and related logs before any physical/thermal action; do not clear. Use markers and immutable action timestamps.
Only a trained operator handles modules, feeds and latches. Verify the exact serial/slot/feed, vendor serviceability, ESD/mechanical state and approved order before contact; automation is read-only.

Before every removal, calculate the specific affected feed group's measured demand, survivor derating/headroom, sharing and rail margin—not merely total chassis capacity—and verify working OOB recovery.

One PSU maximum may be absent. Abort/reinsert on wrong identity/event, group overload/imbalance, rail excursion, unplanned redundancy loss, temperature/fan anomaly, host/BMC instability, input loss outside the plan or mechanical uncertainty.

Run thermal thresholds only with all six-position power configuration restored to its authoritative baseline and a separate approval; never use PSU absence or control-policy changes to force temperature.
No automatic retry, reboot, AC cycle or power cycle. Preserve first evidence and require owner recovery plus a new approval for any later rerun.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant and explicit duplicate row-1522 exclusion; signed PSU1..PSU6 fitted/N/A, serial-slot-feed-group-PMBus-SDR-SEL topology and firmware/tool/script identities
Per-action measured demand, derated survivor/feed-group capacity and imbalance/share calculation, approved sequence/SOP/operator/aborts/recovery
Physical/photo or operator identity evidence and raw SDR/status/SEL assertion/deassertion tied to each fitted slot and timestamp
Synchronized PMBus, PDU/feed/group, rail, load-share, redundancy, fan/temperature, host/BMC traces before, during and after every slot
Same-serial latch/feed restoration, per-slot recovery, final full topology/redundancy/share and retained hashed logs
Separate calibrated threshold/hysteresis/SEL/controller-response evidence and per-slot, N/A, thermal and overall engineer verdicts
test_case.recovery: On any slot anomaly, stop the sequence, preserve all telemetry/SEL and do not touch another PSU. Reduce workload or shut down only through the approved power owner plan; safely reinsert/secure the exact serial, restore its feed and verify PMBus, rails, sharing, redundancy, fans, temperatures, BMC and host. If a feed group overloads, rails destabilize, the module cannot be restored or OOB is lost, follow the pre-approved controlled isolation/shutdown procedure and escalate without an implicit reboot/AC cycle. On thermal-fixture trouble, stop the stimulus, restore cooling/environment and use the thermal recovery owner. Any rerun needs a new authorization after first-failure review.

source_conflict.reason: All six PSU status/load-transfer paths and the temperature-threshold/protection language are retained as separate checkpoints. The duplicate five-reboot row is not treated as authority or evidence for this Source Key/Variant.

blocked.reason: The standard event model and safe six-slot review procedure are well defined. Fitted topology, feed-group capacity, OEM event map, thermal thresholds and service authorization are finite Project configuration and make execution NOT READY, not an unresolved engineering decision.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: PSU1..6 fitted/N/A and serial-slot-feed-group map; SDR/status/SEL oracle; vendor service/order/SOP; per-group load/derating/share/rail/thermal limits; independent threshold/fixture/response matrix; evidence, OOB and approval owners.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; NO PSU, FEED, SENSOR, THERMAL, SEL, LOG, IPMI, REBOOT, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Power Supply sensor type 08h distinguishes presence, failure, predictive failure, input-loss/out-of-range and configuration error; SDR, sensor and SEL structures provide identity and assertion/deassertion fields. It does not define this chassis's six-slot feed topology or safe capacity.

project_authority: The Project power, platform, BMC and thermal owners approve every fitted/N/A slot, serial/feed/group/event mapping, removal order, measured derated capacity, share/rail/thermal limits, vendor service method, threshold response and OOB recovery. They issue per-slot and overall verdicts; approval cannot convert reboot evidence, aggregate-only capacity, an undocumented N/A, missing raw event, skipped slot or unexecuted thermal point into PASS.
